Title: Blank screen while switching video from portrait to landscape full screen for DRM enabled videos in DASH format

3.Rotate the phone to landscape.
4.A blank screen is shown for a sec before the video frame shows up.
5.Switch to portrait again and see the same blank screen

You can check any drm enabled video from the demo app for dash stream.
